title: Knottiness
summary: KNOT'TINESS, noun not'tiness. [from knotty.] 1. Fullness of knots; the quality of having many knots or swellings. 2. Difficulty of solution; intricacy.

inlines.v: KNOT'TINESS, noun not'tiness. [from knotty.] 1. Fullness of knots; the quality of having many knots or swellings. 2. Difficulty of solution; intricacy.
